Obi-Wan… You Jedi can't let Grievous get his metal hands on Bothawui.|Obi-Wan Kenobi learns of General Grievous's impending invasion of Bothawui from Dexter Jettster|}} The '''Battle of Bothawui''' was a [[Realspace/Legends|space]] battle that took place in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. After learning that the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] was planning to invade the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]], the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] dispatched [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and a [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of three newly constructed [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyers]] to [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]] the [[Both system]] in preparation of Grievous's arrival. Accompanied by his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Jedi Commander]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], as well as a unit of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]], Skywalker engaged Grievous several times before arriving over the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Golm|Bothawui Prime]]. [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|CT-7567]], nicknamed "Rex," took multiple [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|AT-TE walkers]] to the planet's [[Golm asteroid belt|asteroid belt]], intending to attack Grievous's [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|frigates]] from the rear once they passed by. The Confederate general arrived in the [[Star system/Legends|system]], and Skywalker led the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] unit [[Gold Squadron (Galactic Republic)/Legends|Gold Squadron]] in [[Anakin Skywalker's Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|his Delta-7B fighter]]. After the Confederate fleet went through the [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid belt]] and passed by the [[Walker/Legends|walkers]], the AT-TEs opened fire, crippling the [[Frigate/Legends|frigates]]. Grievous attempted to escape in [[Soulless One/Legends|his personal fighter]]; and, as Skywalker and his [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] gave pursuit, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi's]] fighter was damaged by flying debris. Rex was able to save Skywalker, but R2-D2 was salvaged by the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Scavenger/Legends|scavenger]] [[Gha Nachkt/Legends|Gha Nachkt]]. ==Prelude== {{Quote|I can't possibly overemphasize the importance of this mission, Anakin. For the first time since the war started, we have the element of surprise. We may never get it again. This could be our only chance to take down Grievous once and for all.|Obi-Wan Kenobi briefs Anakin Skywalker on his mission to protect Bothawui|}} In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] received intelligence from [[Dex's Diner/Legends|diner]] owner [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]] that the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] was planning on invading the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]]. The planet was home to the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] people, who possessed extremely adept information-collecting abilities and who were vital to [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] intelligence. Intending to prevent Grievous from taking Bothawui, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] and [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] devised a plan to [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]] the [[Both system]]. Grievous would be drawn to the bold offensive, and the Republic would be able to trap and eliminate the [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] general. Three new [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyers]] from the [[Allanteen VI shipyards/Legends|Allanteen Six shipyards]] were to be sent to Bothawui under [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker's]] command. The assignment pleased Skywalker, as it was the first time he was to be given his own [[Battle group/Legends|battle group]]. The three [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] of Skywalker's new [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]]—[[Resolute/Legends|''Resolute'']], ''[[Pioneer]]'' and [[Dauntless (Venator-class)|''Dauntless'']]—arrived on the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], and Skywalker himself took the ''Resolute'' as his [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]]. [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]] was assigned to be Skywalker's deck officer aboard the ''Resolute'', while [[Commander/Legends|Commanders]] [[Vontifor]] and [[Isibray]] took charge of the ''Pioneer'' and ''Dauntless''. Skywalker was accompanied by his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Jedi Commander]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]]. A unit of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]]—under the command of [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|CT-7567]], nicknamed "Rex"—was assigned to the battle group, and after preparations for the fleet's departure were completed, the three Star Destroyers left Coruscant. [[File:ReportFromFalleen-DOAD.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Skywalker, Tano, and Rex learn of the defeat at Falleen from Kenobi.]] En route to Bothawui, Skywalker was pursued by four [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class frigates]] under the command of Grievous, and the Republic [[Cruiser/Legends|cruisers]] were knocked out of their [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]] multiple times. In their third engagement with the Confederate [[Frigate/Legends|frigates]], Skywalker was able to delay Grievous before taking a direct [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] course to Bothawui. However, Grievous delayed his pursuit of Skywalker to coordinate attacks on Republic forces on separate fronts. The Confederate general picked up two more frigates and invaded the planet [[Falleen (planet)/Legends|Falleen]], [[Fall of Falleen|overwhelming]] a Republic battle group stationed there, before regaining his original course to Bothawui. Skywalker arrived over the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Golm|Bothawui Prime]] before Grievous and learned of the defeat at Falleen from [[High Jedi General/Legends|High Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]. Although outnumbered two-to-one in [[Starship/Legends|vessels]], Skywalker was intent on preventing Grievous from taking Bothawui. Skywalker deployed [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|AT-TE walkers]] under the command of Rex to the [[Golm asteroid belt|asteroid belt]] surrounding the planet. Once the Confederate fleet passed through the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]], Rex's [[Squad/Legends|squad]] would be able to outflank Grievous's frigates. ==The battle== {{Quote|We're outgunned! We're not going to last a mynock minute out here!|Ahsoka Tano|audio=MynockMinute-DoaD.flac|}} The six Confederate frigates arrived in the [[Star system/Legends|system]], and Grievous ordered his ships to navigate through the asteroid belt, believing that the asteroids would provide suitable protection from the Republic's [[Laser/Legends|laser]] fire. Unaware of Skywalker's deployed AT-TE [[Walker/Legends|walkers]], the cyborg general ordered all of the power of the frigates to be diverted to the [[Deflector shield/Legends|forward shields]]. In [[Anakin Skywalker's Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|his Delta-7B fighter]], Skywalker himself led the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|unit]] [[Gold Squadron (Galactic Republic)/Legends|Gold Squadron]] toward the Confederate fleet, in order to draw Grievous's attention away from the deployed walkers and make the three cruisers' defense appear authentic to the Confederate general. [[File:Munificents_emerge.png|thumb|right|250px|The ''Munificent''-class frigates emerge from the asteroids.]] As the frigates approached, Skywalker and the [[V-19 Torrent starfighter/Legends|V-19 Torrent starfighters]] of Gold Squadron held position. Aboard the ''Resolute'', Tano ordered the cruisers to hold their fire until the AT-TE walkers could engage Grievous's fleet. The Confederate frigates emerged from the asteroids and commenced fire at the Republic cruisers. Outgunned, all of the cruisers sustained damage, and one of the Republic vessels was crippled. Skywalker led his squadron toward the Confederate fleet, but one of the V-19 fighters was hit by laser fire and crashed into another fighter. While his squadron retreated, Skywalker and his [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]], [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], headed toward the Confederate frigates to confront the fleet at a closer proximity. The unsuspecting Confederate frigates passed by the walkers, and Rex and his men opened fire. As Grievous realized he had been outflanked, the walkers attacked the frigates' unprotected sterns. One of the Confederate vessels was destroyed, and Tano ordered the Republic fleet to commence fire at their adversaries. A frigate fell to laser fire from the Republic cruisers, and Skywalker destroyed the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] of another vessel with his fighter, disabling the frigate. Realizing that he had been defeated, Grievous boarded his personal fighter, [[Soulless One/Legends|''Soulless One'']], and fled from his [[Grievous's frigate/Legends|command ship]] and the rest of his outmatched frigates. As the Republic cruisers targeted what remained of the Confederate fleet, Skywalker gave pursuit of Grievous, but the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi's]] fighter was hit by flying debris. While Grievous was able to jump to hyperspace and escape, Skywalker's fighter exploded and veered toward the asteroid belt. ==Aftermath== {{Quote|Where's Artoo?''"
"''I'm sorry, Master, he's… gone.|Anakin Skywalker and Ahsoka Tano|audio=ArtoosGone-DownfallOfADroid.flac|}} [[File:Anakins_Delta-7B_wreckage.png|thumb|left|250px|The wreckage of Skywalker's Delta-7B starfighter]] Rex led the search-and-rescue mission that saved Skywalker from the asteroid belt,{{TCW|Downfall of a Droid|d=y}} and the Jedi was tended to by a [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droid]] aboard the ''Resolute''. However, Rex was unable to save R2-D2. Skywalker was left dismayed, as he had developed an attachment to the droid. As such, the Jedi had never wiped the [[Droid/Legends|droid's]] [[Memory bank/Legends|memory banks]] of secret Republic information. When Kenobi—who had been witness to the battle in a [[Force vision/Legends|Force vision]]—learned of this, he ordered Skywalker to find the droid, as the information would prove fatal to the Republic in the hands of the Confederacy. Unbeknownst to the Jedi, the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Scavenger/Legends|scavenger]] [[Gha Nachkt/Legends|Gha Nachkt]] found R2-D2 and promised the droid to Grievous in exchange for [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. Skywalker and Tano were assigned a replacement astromech droid, [[R3-S6/Legends|R3-S6]], and departing the Republic fleet in Skywalker's personal ship, the [[Twilight/Legends|''Twilight'']], the Jedi [[Ambush on the Vulture's Claw/Legends|searched]] the asteroid field for R2-D2. Skywalker and Tano discovered the wreckage of Skywalker's fighter but found that R2-D2 was missing from the fighter's [[Astromech socket/Legends|astromech socket]]. The Jedi came across the [[Vulture's Claw/Legends|''Vulture's Claw'']], Nachkt's [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]], and disguised themselves as peasants before entering the ship and searching for R2-D2 among the scavenger's wares. General Grievous's loss at Bothawui added to a number of his recent defeats, eventually leading Confederate [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] to arrange a [[Mission to Grievous's castle/Legends|test]] for him.{{SW|url=news/chronicling-the-clone-wars-4|text=Chronicling ''The Clone Wars'' #4|int=Chronicling The Clone Wars}} ==Behind the scenes== The Battle of Bothawui was featured in "[[Downfall of a Droid]]," an episode in the [[The Clone Wars: Season One|first season]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series. The battle was later expanded upon in the [[December]] [[2008]] novel ''[[The Clone Wars: Wild Space]]'', written by [[Karen Miller]]. Series Director [[Dave Filoni]] and Series Writer [[Henry Gilroy]] noted that the element of the AT-TE walkers in space was used to make the battle more dynamic and interesting because of a lack of assets available for producing the episode.[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars The Complete Season One|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' The Complete Season One]], DVD Featurette for "[[Downfall of a Droid]]" The ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: The Visual Guide]]'' sourcebook implies that Skywalker's troops were on the surface of Bothawui itself, but no other source expanded upon this or clarified it. The planet that Skywalker defends in the episode, originally identified as Bothawui, was [[Retroactive continuity|retconned]] to be named Bothawui Prime in the [[2009]] ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''. Author [[Jason Fry]] established Bothawui Prime to be another name for the gas giant Golm,{{JCFCite|url=posts/30367601|board=Literature|thread=The Essential Atlas and Galactic Cartography: Official Discussion|user=[[Jason Fry|jasonfry]]|date=2009-08-21|time=7:17 AM}} a planet first created for the [[1996]] ''[[Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide]]''.''[[Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide]]''
